The 2010 Italian Grand Prix was held at Monza on 12 September 2010, and the search results list Fernando Alonso (Ferrari) as the winner, ahead of Jenson Button (McLaren) in second and Felipe Massa (Ferrari) in third.

ANSWER: Fernando Alonso
